create_LangStats: create a LangStats pipeline component to compute language detection stats for a specified language
run_extract_stats: run extract_stats on a Document to get fasttext language score as a dictionary metric
build_LangStats_init: build a LangStats instance with output_folder, language, groups_to_compute, histogram_round_digits, and top_k_config
test_LangStats_extract_stats: test the LangStats extract_stats method returns fasttext language score from document metadata or prediction
review_LangStats: review the LangStats class that extends BaseStats and uses FT176LID for language identification
